correctness.rationale: For every clique blade, selected outer vertices share exactly the same distance multiset and unselected outer vertices likewise. Adjacent equal-status pairs therefore obstruct local multiset resolving sets when a blade has >=3 noncentral vertices (t>=4). In triangle blades exactly one of the two outer vertices must be selected; each such selection set resolves every edge, giving lmd=r and 2^r bases. Star t=2 is bipartite and every singleton resolves locally. Independent small-parameter enumeration confirms t=2 dimensions1; t=3 dimensions r and 2^r bases; t=4 impossible.
